title: Patient Hardship Discount Program: Income Documentation Standards by Level
content:
Each level of the Patient Hardship Discount Program sets whether income documents are required, which documents are accepted as proof, how old they may be, when they are due and how far that due date may move. These standards also set the open patient balance an applicant must carry to apply at a level.

## Documentation table

| Level | Income documents required | Documents accepted as proof | Signed attestation of no income replaces income documents | Oldest document accepted, in calendar days before the application date | Documents due, calendar days after the application date | Calendar days one extension adds | Extensions allowed per application | Minimum open patient balance to apply |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hardship Discount Level 1 (25%) | Yes | Pay stubs, tax return, unemployment letter, benefits letter, attestation | Yes | 90 | 30 | 14 | 1 | $0.00 (none) |
| Hardship Discount Level 2 (50%) | Yes | Pay stubs, tax return, unemployment letter, benefits letter, attestation | Yes | 90 | 30 | 14 | 1 | $0.00 (none) |
| Hardship Discount Level 3 (75%) | Yes | Pay stubs, tax return, unemployment letter, benefits letter, attestation | Yes | 90 | 30 | 14 | 1 | $0.00 (none) |
| Hardship Discount Level 4 (100%) | Yes | Pay stubs, tax return, unemployment letter, benefits letter, attestation | Yes | 90 | 30 | 14 | 1 | $0.00 (none) |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship | Yes | Pay stubs, tax return, unemployment letter, benefits letter | No | 90 | 30 | 14 | 1 | $1000.00 |
| Presumptive Eligibility Discount | No | Benefits letter | No | 90 | 14 | 14 | 1 | $0.00 (none) |

## Meaning of the columns

- **Income documents required** states whether income documents must be provided at the level.
- **Documents accepted as proof** lists the kinds of document the level accepts.
- **Attestation** states whether a signed attestation of no income replaces income documents.
- **Oldest document accepted** is the maximum age of a document on the application date.
- **Documents due** is the number of calendar days after the application date by which documents must be received.
- **One extension adds** is the number of calendar days a single extension adds to the documents due date; **extensions allowed** is how many such extensions one application may have.
- **Minimum open patient balance** is the open patient balance the applicant must have on the application date to apply at the level; $0.00 means there is no minimum.

## What the figures give (derived from the table)

| Level | Latest possible documents due date, counted from the application date |
|---|---|
| Hardship Discount Level 1 (25%) to Level 4 (100%) | 44 calendar days (30, extended once by 14) |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship | 44 calendar days (30, extended once by 14) |
| Presumptive Eligibility Discount | 28 calendar days (14, extended once by 14) |

A document dated 90 calendar days or fewer before the application date is within the age limit at every level; one dated 91 calendar days before it is not.
